subtopic: 04 · Graphs and Periodicity of Trigonometric Functions
title: A graph is the unit circle, unrolled

board_content.text: Unrolling the circle into a wave
Walk anticlockwise round the unit circle and plot your height, sin x, against the distance walked. The height traces a wave.

board_content.caption: y = sin x: the unit circle's height unrolled along a line

board_content.text: Height rises to $+1$ at $\tfrac{\pi}{2}$, back to $0$ at $\pi$, down to $-1$ at $\tfrac{3\pi}{2}$, and $0$ again at $2\pi$.

board_content.latex: f(x+T)=f(x),\quad T\ \text{the smallest such positive number}

board_content.text: Sine and cosine repeat every full turn, $T=2\pi$. Tangent repeats every half turn, $T=\pi$.
Tangent depends on the line's direction, which looks 'the same' after 180° — hence period π.

segments_english.text: A graph turns trigonometry from something you compute into something you can see.

Here's the trick: walk anticlockwise around the unit circle, and at each angle x plot your height, which is sine x, against the distance you've walked. That height, laid out along a line, is the sine wave.
This is it. The wave is literally the circle's up-coordinate, unrolled.

Follow the height: it rises to plus one at pi over two, drops back to zero at pi, dips to minus one at three pi over two, and returns to zero at two pi. Then a new lap begins and the whole shape repeats.
That repetition has a name, periodicity.
A function is periodic with period capital T if f of x plus T always equals f of x, and T is the smallest positive number that works.
Sine and cosine repeat every full turn, so their period is two pi. Tangent, though, repeats every half turn, its period is pi.
Why only pi for tangent? Tangent measures the direction of the line through the origin, and a line points the same way again after just one hundred eighty degrees.

segments_hinglish.text: Graph trigonometry को compute करने वाली चीज़ से देखने वाली चीज़ बना देता है.
Trick ये है: unit circle के around anticlockwise चलिए, और हर angle x पर अपनी height, यानी sine x, को चली हुई distance के against plot कीजिए. वो height, एक line पर बिछी हुई, sine wave है.
ये रहा. Wave literally circle की up-coordinate है, unrolled.
Height follow कीजिए: pi over two पर plus one तक चढ़ती है, pi पर वापस zero, three pi over two पर minus one तक गिरती है, और two pi पर फिर zero. फिर नया lap शुरू, पूरी shape repeat.
इस repetition का नाम है periodicity.
एक function periodic है period capital T के साथ अगर f of x plus T हमेशा f of x के बराबर हो, और T सबसे छोटा positive number जो काम करे.
Sine और cosine हर full turn पर repeat होते हैं, so period two pi. पर tangent हर half turn पर repeat होता है, इसका period pi.
Tangent के लिए pi ही क्यों? Tangent origin से गुज़रती line की direction नापता है, और line सिर्फ़ one hundred eighty degrees बाद फिर same तरफ़ point करती है.
